sources.paper: Shallow-Deep Collaborative Learning for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
retained: Neighbor-based contrastive learning and detached instance memory
Historical CNN/MRFP code only; not instantiated in the current model

adaptations: No CNN or shallow readout branch; one fused CLS descriptor
Fixed equal mean of raw CLS9-12, original BN head and L2 retrieval
Global ID+Triplet plus 0.1 times single-space supervised cross-camera neighbor loss
One training-image memory; same-ID cross-camera neighbor selection in the fused descriptor space
The original deep/shallow neighbor intersection is removed; this is a single-space adaptation, not original SDCL CNL
Unselected same-ID images are excluded from negatives; self excluded before neighbor threshold
Detached targets, duplicate image means, memory update only after successful AMP optimizer step
No CRA pseudo-label association, no extra pretraining or spatial body partition

legacy_injection.paper: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions
legacy_injection.implementation: Independent CoMer-inspired CPPI-Lite adaptation, not a reproduction of original CTI
adaptations: One-way forward feature flow; all branches remain jointly differentiable
Fixed local 3x3 candidates at three scales replace deformable attention
Nonzero up projection, image-wide normalized residual direction, and independent positive learnable budgets initialized to 5% replace zero-initialized gamma
Budget uses softplus with no upper clamp and no weight decay; ID+Triplet determines its learned value
CNN/MRFP GroupNorm replaces original batch normalization
CNN and MRFP computed once, four independent CTI reads
Original ReID CLS retained and only patch tokens directly modified
CLS9-12 equal 768D readout replaces dense prediction heads

parameters.budget_mode: per-stage softplus, trainable, no upper limit

historical_checkpoint_compatibility: Missing CNN_SD_QUERY in old dumps resolves to cls11; original architecture variant retained
control: cppi_baseline.yml and cppi_no_cnl.yml are aliases of the matched single-descriptor CNL=0 control
